3) Who from TI would you expect to join the initial call (roles/functional areas)?
4) Do you have any materials you can share in advance (a short brief, slides, or relevant papers)?
5) Any preferred dates/times for a 30–45 minute call next week?

If you prefer, suggest a few slots and I’ll confirm availability on our side. Looking forward to learning more.

Best regards,
Vince J. Kaminski
Enron Research Corp.
vince.j.kaminski@enron.com
